description: Reads the workspace’s billing in one of four views. subscription: plan, status, billing period and whether payment is overdue. plans: the plans it may move to, in order, with prices, allowances, seats and features. invoices: when, how much and whether paid, with Stripe’s own document. invoice: one of them. Paying and changing a card happen on a set-up link. Read-only.

invoiceId.description: The invoice’s Stripe id, from the invoice list (view invoice).

view.description: subscription for the current plan, status and period; plans for the plans this workspace may move to; invoices for every invoice; invoice for one, named by invoiceId.

name: get_billing
title: Read plan and invoices
